patterns_found.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
patterns_found.evidence: Prior downtrend from 1900 to 1725 created lower lows. Price then formed a higher low near 1775 and broke above the prior swing high at 1825, indicating a bullish change of character.

patterns_found.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders
patterns_found.evidence: Left shoulder near 1775, head at 1725, right shoulder near 1775-1780. Neckline resistance around 1825. Price currently trading above neckline at approximately 1836.

patterns_found.name: Ascending Triangle
patterns_found.evidence: Series of higher lows (1725, 1775, 1820) approaching horizontal resistance near 1845-1850.
